name: process_madvise
synopsis: ssize_t process_madvise(int pidfd, const struct iovec *iovec, size_t n, int advice, unsigned int flags);
description: The process_madvise() system call gives advice to the kernel about the memory usage of another process or the calling process, specified by a PID file descriptor. It applies the advice to the address ranges described by an array of iovec structures to potentially improve system or application performance.

parameters.name: pidfd
parameters.description: PID file descriptor that specifies the target process

parameters.name: iovec
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of iovec structures describing the address ranges

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: Number of elements in the iovec array

parameters.name: advice
parameters.description: Advice value, such as MADV_COLD, MADV_PAGEOUT, MADV_WILLNEED, or MADV_COLLAPSE

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Reserved for future use; must be 0

return_value.success: Returns the number of bytes advised, which may be less than requested if partial advice was applied
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: pidfd is not a valid PID file descriptor
The memory described by iovec is outside the accessible address space of the process
The sum of the iov_len values overflows a ssize_t value
Could not allocate memory for internal copies of the iovec structures
The caller does not have permission to access the address space of the process
The target process does not exist
